title: Simplicity of action-based $C^{*}$-algebras from hyperbolic actions
summary: We study the simplicity of $C^{*}$-algebras built from group actions. For a faithful isometric action of a group $G$ on a countable metric space $X$, we use the associated action representation on $\ell^2(X)$ to define the action-based $C^{*}$-algebra $C^{*}_{X}G$. We define generalized versions of the properties $P_{\mathrm{naive}}$ and $P_{\mathrm{analytic}}$ relative to this action and show that the naive form implies the analytic form.
